## Definition of Done

- [ ] Acceptance criteria from the issue are met
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit / API / E2E as appropriate) and CI is green
- [ ] No new accessibility violations (axe) on touched pages
- [ ] Docs, `ARCHITECTURE.md` or an ADR updated if behaviour or structure changed
- [ ] Privacy impact considered: new personal data? retention? included in export and delete?
- [ ] Risky changes are behind a feature flag and can be turned off
- [ ] No secrets, real CVs or personal data in code, fixtures, logs or this description
